message: Hi, my kid Ian is 8 and wants to try jiu jitsu. Do you have classes for that age?

Hey! Yes, we do! We have Kids Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu for ages 6-13, so Ian would be a great fit. It's a fun, safe environment and no experience needed. Would you like to get him signed up for a free trial class?
Yes, that sounds great! What time is the free trial class?
Great! Let me have the team reach out with the exact schedule for the kids class. I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Perfect, thanks Tester! And what's the best email to send the trial details to?
You can send the details to tester.beacon@gmail.com.
Got it! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
Perfect! Last thing - can I get Ian's full name and date of birth? This helps us get him set up in the system.
Sure! His full name is Ian Beacon, and he was born on March 30, 2018.

Awesome! Ian is all set. I have some open spots for his free trial class.
How about one of these times:

- Wednesday, July 8 at 5:30 PM
- Thursday, July 9 at 5:30 PM
- Monday, July 13 at 5:00 PM

Which works best for you?
Let's go with Wednesday, July 8 at 5:30 PM.

Perfect! Ian is booked for Wednesday, July 8 at 5:30 PM. We'll send a confirmation to tester.beacon@gmail.com with all the details. Just have him wear comfortable clothes he can move in. See you both then!
